sentences.text: This first bail application has been filed by applicant under section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.276/2023 registered at Police Station Kailaras Distrist Morena (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 407, 420, 467, 468 and 471 of IPC.
Applicant was arrested on 19.01.2024.

As per the case of prosecution, Arun Singhal reported to PS Kailaras that he had sent 400 bags (total quantity 270 Quintals) of Mustard-straw worth Rs.7,44,833/- to Ganeshi Solvex Pvt. Ltd. Morena by Truck No.MP07 HB 2614.
He was informed by Ganeshi Solvex Pvt. Ltd. Morena that they have not received transported article Mustard-straw.
The truck along with Mustard-straw is missing.
The driver is not picking up the phone.
On such allegations, PS Kailaras registered FIR in Crime No.276/2023 for offence punishable under Sections 407 of IPC against unknown driver.

sentences.text: Singh and Digvijay Singh were intercepted and taken into custody by PS Kailaras.
They informed that they had replaced the registration number plate of Truck No.MP07 HB 3090 with number Plate No.MP07 HB 2614.
Santosh Singh got 27 Tonnes of Mustard-straw loaded in the truck.
While transporting the straw, the truck met with an accident near village Nandpura.
Thereafter, they tried to sell off the Mustard-straw and concealed remaining Gunny bags at the house of Digvijay Singh.
Accordingly, relevant seizure were made.
Digvijay was arrested on 19.01.2024 and he is in custody ever-since.
On completion of investigation, final report was submitted.

Learned Counsel for the applicant, in addition to the grounds mentioned in the application, submits that the applicant is falsely implicated in the matter merely on the basis of suspicion as truck on way to Morena met with an accident.
He had kept the articles at his residence for security purpose only.
Learned counsel submits that the applicant is a transporter by profession.
He has a family to look-after.
He is sole bread earner of the family.
There is no likelihood of his absconding leaving behind his family and business.
There is no likelihood of interfering with the investigation or tampering with the evidence.
No criminal antecedent is reported against the applicant.
The trial would take time to complete.
Therefore, applicant may be extended the benefit of bail.
Per contra, learned Counsel for the State opposes the bail application on the ground of gravity of alleged offence.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
Considering the arguments advanced by both the parties and overall circumstances of the case but without commenting on merits of the case, this Court is inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Thus, the application is allowed.
